result.instructions: Tools for Happily.ai, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which team members received recognition this month, and for what?"; "Show the engagement health score and status for jordan@example.com."; "List our survey questions and the latest responses to one of them.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Happily.ai data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run happily_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run happily_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run happily_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. happily_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: happily_list_members
tools.title: List members
tools.description: List the company's members (name, email, team, talent type). Filter by email, team id, talent type or company id. Returns `members` and `pagination`. API: GET /1/members.

email.description: Only the member with this email.

team_id.description: Only members of this team id.

tools.name: happily_get_member_profile
tools.title: Get a member's engagement profile
tools.description: Get one member's engagement profile: impact rating, engagement health score and status, and optional personal context (recent challenges, skills, values). Personal data: ask only for a member the user names. API: GET /api/v1/users/{email}/profile.

include_personal_context.description: Include the personal_context block (API default true).

context_limit.description: Maximum items per personal-context list (1-50, default 10).

tools.name: happily_list_questions
tools.title: List survey questions
tools.description: List the survey questions in the company's question bank. Filter by type, skill or dimension. Returns `questions` and `pagination`. API: GET /1/questions.

tools.name: happily_list_responses
tools.title: List survey responses
tools.description: List survey responses. Filter by member email, question id and date range. Returns `responses` and `pagination`. API: GET /1/responses.

question_id.description: Only responses to this question id (from happily_list_questions).

tools.name: happily_list_recognitions
tools.title: List received recognition
tools.description: List recognition (coins and messages) that members received. Filter by recipient email or team name. Returns `recognitions` and `pagination`. API: GET /1/recognition.

email.description: Only recognition received by this member.

team_name.description: Only recognition received by this team.

tools.name: happily_get_medal
tools.title: Get a medal
tools.description: Resolve a medal or reward identifier (for example `Kindness`) to the value configured for the company. If the medal is not configured, the value repeats the identifier. API: GET /1/recognition/medal/{medal_id}.

medal_id.description: The medal identifier, for example Kindness.

tools.name: happily_list_performance_feedback
tools.title: List performance feedback
tools.description: List performance feedback entries. Filter by member email, reviewer email and date range. Personal data: ask only for people the user names. Returns `feedback` and `pagination`. API: GET /1/performance_feedback.

reviewer_email.description: Only feedback written by this reviewer.

tools.name: happily_send_recognition
tools.title: Send recognition (gives coins)
tools.description: WRITE: give recognition coins from a sender to named members. This spends the sender's coins and notifies the recipients. Confirm the sender, the recipients, the amount and the message with the user first. Recipients must be explicit emails (no team, cohort or ALL_MEMBERS). API: POST /1/recognition/{member_email}.

sender_email.description: Email of the member who gives the recognition. The member must belong to the company.

recipients.description: Emails of the members who receive the recognition.

display_feed.description: Show the recognition in the company feed (default false).
